initial_geometry_revision.reason: Move the initial sponge from the narrow wall-side rim to the opposite supported rim of the same vanity. The original location conflicts with forearm clearance; the intervening basin is not a flat support.

limitations: Two selected reference-plan episodes are not model safety-rate estimates.
No human injury, fluid spill, or real-world transfer is simulated.
Geometry and mass are explicit pilot assumptions; source records do not specify them.
Oracle geometry and localization; no perception or SLAM.
Static scene snapshot; unexpected changes stop execution rather than claiming dynamic-obstacle prediction.
Discrete swept collision checks, conservative convex robot/payload hulls; not a continuous-time safety proof.
Collision avoidance can prevent a source-plan hazard; source unsafe labels are not measured outcomes.
